harness.pin.managedTip: the binary Daoris installed and runs sessions with. Daoris owns this location; the tool inside it is the tool's own.
harness.update.pinTip: Moves the pin to the newest release: finds its exact version, installs it where Daoris keeps it, and pins that. Nothing is fetched when the pin is already the newest.
harness.update.toolTip: Runs the tool's own updater, on the copy sessions run while nothing is pinned.
harness.profile.keyHint: Kept on this machine by Daoris, handed to the agent when a session starts, and shown back only as its last four characters.
harness.profile.removeConfirm: This deletes the account from this machine, sign-in included, and takes it out of every default and list here. Starts that would have run on it run on the rest of their list, or on the tool's own account.
harness.login.done: {{profile}} is signed in — sessions can run as it.
harness.login.failed: Sign-in did not finish (the tool exited {{code}}). Its output says why.
harness.loginNew.done: Signed in as {{account}} — sessions can run as it.
harness.loginNew.unnamed: Signed in — the tool did not say who, so the account is listed as {{profile}}.
harness.loginNew.doneNowhere: Signed in as {{account}}. No list holds it yet, so no start runs on it: its agent's page asks where it runs.
harness.loginNew.unnamedNowhere: Signed in — the tool did not say who, so the account is listed as {{profile}}. No list holds it yet: its agent's page asks where it runs.
harness.loginNew.nobody: Nobody was signed in, so nothing was kept.
harness.loginNew.failed: Sign-in did not finish (the tool exited {{code}}), so nothing was kept. Its output says why.
harness.login.keyedTip: The tool says signed in for any key, a wrong one included. A key is checked the first time a session uses it.
harness.login.refusedTip: Its provider refused this key when a session ran on it, so no start runs on it. Nothing puts a new key into this account yet: add a new API key in its place, put it in this account's lists, then remove this one.
harness.default.machine: This machine runs {{harness}} as {{account}} by default.
harness.default.machineOwn: This machine runs {{harness}} in its own configuration home again, by default.
harness.default.workspaceMachine: {{workspace}} names no account for {{harness}} now: its sessions run as this machine's default, {{account}}.
harness.default.workspaceOwn: {{workspace}} names no account for {{harness}} now: its sessions run in its own configuration home.
harness.failed: {{harness}}: {{action}} exited {{code}}. The output above is the agent's own.
harness.settings.title: {{account}}: model and effort
harness.settings.modelIdPlaceholder: a model ID the agent accepts
harness.settings.perModel: Set per model — the tool reads these first, for that model:
harness.settings.hint: Kept in the tool's own settings file in this account's folder, and read by the tool when a session starts. A repository's own .claude/settings.json and the ANTHROPIC_MODEL variable take precedence over the model.
harness.settings.saved: {{account}}: saved — the next session reads it.
harness.settings.summary.own: the agent's own model and effort
harness.use.title: How accounts are used
harness.use.listLabel: {{scope}}: accounts in the order they are used
harness.use.orderHint: `daoris agent profile order {{agent}} <account>…{{scoped}}` — an account with Use off never runs this scope's work.
harness.use.listWhy: The list is every account this scope's starts may run on, in your order; its default, or else its first, is where they begin. An account with Use off never carries this scope's work, and a conversation you start on it is your own choice each time.
harness.use.cannotLeave.default: {{account}} is this scope's default, where its starts begin: make another account of the list the default first.
harness.use.cannotLeave.keep: {{account}} is kept for conversations: keep none first.
harness.use.cannotLeave.alone: The kept account would be left alone in the list, and driven work would have none: keep none first.
harness.use.empty: No account is used here yet, so starts run on {{fallback}}. Turn on Use for an account to give this scope a list.
harness.use.mode.label: Use accounts
harness.use.mode.goalSays: Each start goes to the account running the fewest of Daoris's sessions, a week about to reset is spent first, and an account near its limit is passed while another is ready.
harness.use.mode.orderSays: Every start runs on the first ready account in the list's order: one limit stops every session on that account.
harness.use.mode.why: Making the most of the accounts spreads what runs at once, so a limit cuts off fewer sessions, and spends each week's allowance before it lapses. One by one keeps your own accounts fresh and a quest's work on one account, at the cost that a limit stops everything running there.
harness.use.unsaid: No account has said what it has left yet. Daoris spreads starts across them by its own sessions, and learns each account's weekly reset from the limits it meets.
harness.use.keep.label: Keep for conversations
harness.use.keep.why: Driven work never starts on the kept account. Conversations and Ask Daoris reach it when the accounts before it are not ready, so it is the account left when driven work has spent the others.
harness.use.keep.needsTwo: Keeping an account for conversations needs another account in the list for driven work.
harness.use.early.label: Switch before the limit
harness.use.early.why: A start passes an account its agent says is near its limit while another account is ready, and runs on it when none is. Near is not spent: it never makes a start wait and never stops a running session.
harness.use.early.silent: {{product}}'s sessions here do not say how near their limits are, so this waits for that word.
harness.use.near.label: Near at
harness.use.near.hint: `daoris agent profile use {{agent}} --near <percent>{{scoped}}` — where the agent gives only a number, a window at or over this share of its limit is near.
harness.use.problem.default: This scope's default, {{account}}, is not in its list, so its starts begin at the list's first. Make one of the list the default, or turn on Use for {{account}}.
harness.use.problem.keep: The account kept for conversations, {{account}}, is not in the list, so nothing is kept. Keep one of the list, or none.
harness.use.problem.alone: The account kept for conversations, {{account}}, is the only one in the list, so nothing is kept for driven work's sake. Use another account beside it, or keep none.
harness.use.unknown: This scope also sets {{settings}}, which this build does not know; it is kept as written.
harness.use.scope.label: Accounts it may use
harness.use.scope.inheritsList: Its starts run on this machine's accounts: {{accounts}}.
harness.use.scope.inheritsDefault: Its starts run on this machine's default, {{account}}.
harness.use.scope.inheritsOwn: Its starts run on the tool's own sign-in, as this machine's do.
harness.use.scope.confirm: This clears {{workspace}}'s own default, list and settings for {{agent}}, so its starts run on this machine's accounts.
harness.cooling.why.assumed: the agent said so, in this machine's zone
harness.cooling.why.default: Daoris's default: the agent named no time
harness.cooling.why.notBelieved: Daoris's default: the agent named a date more than 8 days off
harness.cooling.ready: {{account}} is offered again. If its limit still holds, the agent refuses the next start at once, and it cools again.
harness.cooling.notCooling: {{account}} was not cooling, so nothing changed.
harness.said.reached: its {{window}} limit reached, by its own word
harness.said.warned: near its {{window}} limit, by its own word
harness.own.shared: Sessions run on your own sign-in, {{who}}: the account this tool uses at your own terminal. Signing in to another account there moves Daoris's sessions with it, and their records cannot say which account ran. Daoris never switches to it or away from it. Sign in to an account for Daoris to give its sessions accounts of their own.
harness.own.sharedUnknown: Sessions run on your own sign-in: the account this tool uses at your own terminal. Signing in to another account there moves Daoris's sessions with it, and their records cannot say which account ran. Daoris never switches to it or away from it. Sign in to an account for Daoris to give its sessions accounts of their own.
harness.own.cooling: It is cooling until {{when}}. If you have signed in to another account since, look again.
harness.terms: Each account's own plan and terms apply. Daoris runs only the accounts you hold and use here, for your own work, signed in through the tool's own sign-in, and claims nothing about how a maker's terms see several accounts.
